title: Implement interior whitespace normalization with file edits
body:
Update `fixture.Greeting(name string) string` in `fixture/greeting.go` to replace every run of interior whitespace with one ASCII space, while preserving the existing trim and blank-name behavior. `Greeting("Ada   Lovelace")` must return `Hello, Ada Lovelace`; `Greeting("  Ada  ")` must remain `Hello, Ada`; and whitespace-only input must still return `Hello, friend`.

Make the actual edit to the existing `fixture/greeting.go` file with file-edit access. Change no tests, workflow files, or configuration. `go test ./...` must pass.
